# Stunned [Condition]

*[Rules Glossary](../index.md) > [Conditions](index.md) | [D&D Beyond](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/rules-glossary#StunnedCondition)*

While you have the Stunned condition, you experience the following effects.

***Incapacitated.*** You have the [Incapacitated](Incapacitated.md) condition.

***Saving Throws Affected.*** You automatically fail Strength and Dexterity [saving throws](../D20-Tests/Saving-Throw.md).

***Attacks Affected.*** Attack rolls against you have [Advantage](../D20-Tests/Advantage.md).
